flow_summary: The interviewer recovers some vague answers (DOB format, phone number) by re-asking in a specific format, but frequently accepts disorganised responses without pursuit (full name, address) and loops on "I don’t know" for biological treatments by asking when/where/how many/lasting benefit after the patient already stated unknowns. Transitions are often mechanical, with one clear question at a time but little redirection or breaking down of rambling replies.

issues.evidence: After patient’s vague name reply ("Eleanor… um, Haywood. But if you need it exactly..."), interviewer immediately asks gender without clarification.
Patient gives partial address ("Balliol Street... tangled up") and offers to be asked piece by piece; interviewer switches to postal code instead.
After "I don’t know—I haven’t had any of those" for biological treatments, interviewer asks four follow-ups (when, where, sessions, benefit duration) despite repeated "I don’t know" answers.
